ul.li: If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated, select the appropriate BPC on the Dormant tab and select Reactivate . Go to step 8.
If the claim is active or converted to MPS, go to step 9.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 20.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the AI WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + one business day.
When the WI moves to the current workload, go to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number on file related to the same issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Failure to provide entitlement information.”

Details: Type “No return call from the client or the employer. 15 - Claim Procedure disentitlement imposed for failure to provide entitlement information. Information missing. Cannot input the allocation of vacation pay.”

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the CS is 8 - Converted to Manual Pay :

ul.li: If yes, note that a D15 from the Monday following the week displayed in the Last claimant’s report processed field of the Manual Pay tab in FTS must be included in the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to IPOC. Go to step 16.

step.cmd: Select the Payments tab. Under Benefit Type , determine if the message 9000 - Cycling payment is displayed:
Determine if the MA has been imposed for the same issue or another issue:

ul.li: If the MA has been imposed for the same issue, go to step 14.
If the MA has been imposed for another issue and the allocation of vacation pay has an impact on cycling claimant’s reports, go to step 14.
If the MA has been imposed for another issue and the allocation of vacation pay has no impact on cycling claimant’s reports, go to step 15.

step.cmd: Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlement (M161) transaction to input the D15 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Start date: Enter the Monday of the first cycling claimant’s report displayed in FTS.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .

step.cmd: Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlement (M161) transaction to input the D15 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Start date: Enter the Monday of the next claimant’s report to be received displayed in FTS.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the allocation.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1 : Type “D15 from w/c [XXXX-X] to 9999.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: D48 and D15 — Moved — Address unknown and claim procedure (3006)
D15 - Text: Insert appropriate reason for D15

Text - Insert appropriate reason(s) (1618): Type the appropriate option:
“you have not returned our call[s] following the message[s] left on [date[s]].”
“you have not contacted us following the letter sent to you on [date].”

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Failure to provide entitlement information.”

Details: Type “No return call from the client or the employer. Information missing. Cannot input the allocation of vacation pay. No 15 - Claim Procedure disentitlement imposed because the claim is [blocked or archived].”

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number on file related to the same issue :

ul.li:
If yes, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the registration number as follows:
Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
